conditions: The rule concerns an object whose identifier was declared using the specified storage-class specifier.
limitations: This records the rule in the working draft. It does not generalize a result when an object is accessed indirectly from another thread or assert behavior in the published standard.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: WG14 working draft N3220 gives an object declared with thread_local thread storage duration and associates a distinct object with each thread.
